waiting_for_game: Waiting for the game to arrive from the other devices. If nothing happens, the code may be wrong or you may be on a different network.
removed: The host removed you from this game. You can still start or join a different one.
pack_mismatch: Your question pack does not match this game. You would be asked different questions from everyone else. Update both devices before playing.
diverged: This device disagrees with another about what has happened in this game. That should not be possible; restart the game rather than playing on.
peer_version_mismatch: Another device in this room is running a different version of Dohhh or a different question pack. It has been ignored rather than risking a mismatched game - update every device to the same version.
confusable_names: {{a}} and {{b}} have names that look identical at a glance - worth checking who's actually who before the game gets going.
mesh_warning: {{count}} devices connected. Every device connects to every other, so this has been tested to about eight. Expect it to get slow.

invite.title: Invite
invite.description: Have them point a camera at this, or read the words out.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Any number per team. Join one, or switch - joining another moves you off the last one.
teams.none_yet: No teams yet. Make the first one.

room.title: Room
room.description: The join code is the only lock this game has otherwise - closing the door stops anyone new from joining, whether or not they have it. Players already here are unaffected.
room.open: Open - anyone with the code can join

start.pick_team: Pick a team, then wait for the host.
start.ready_waiting: Ready. Waiting for the host to start.
